purpose: Source bundle for compiling the stylized humanoid mannequin rig from existing local human proportion profiles and extracted region-map image lanes.

human_profile_source.source_role: body height, broad anthropometric landmark proportions, and measurement provenance

human_dimension_sources.source_role: region-specific skull, pelvis, and lower-limb measurement bundles
canonical skeleton/body-frame terminology and sanity ranges
lower-half proportion ranges for feet, pelvis, and leg checks

region_lane_source.source_role: region-map image lane bboxes, colors, component counts, mask paths, and cutout paths

notes: The extracted image is a 3/4 projected pixel rig; source bboxes drive the visible silhouette.
Human profile dimensions are stored as measurement provenance and broad sanity anchors, not forced true-depth geometry.
